name: com.devicerts/medical-devices
title: deviCERTS medical device regulatory data
description: FDA 510(k)/PMA/De Novo, GUDID, recall and EUDAMED device and certificate data. Read-only, no login.

tools.name: search_devices
tools.description: Search the DevicErts medical device catalogue by text, with filters for registry, region, risk class and manufacturer, and offset paging. Returns up to 20 devices per page (slug, page URL, manufacturer, risk class, registries, status, primary reference, UDI-DI), the total, next_offset and more_results_url. Use when a device is described by name, type, model or company, or a filtered list is needed. Prefer this over `search`. Do not use for an exact 510(k), PMA, De Novo number or UDI-DI (use find_device_by_identifier) or for companies (use search_manufacturers). Pass a slug to get_device for the full record. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 200 characters: device or trade name, device type, model or catalogue number, or manufacturer name. e.g. "insulin pump", "MiniMed 780G"

registry.description: Only devices listed in this registry: eudamed (EU), fda_510k (FDA 510(k) and De Novo), fda_pma (FDA PMA) or fda_udi (FDA GUDID). Default: all.

region.description: Only devices listed in a registry of this region: EU (EUDAMED) or US (any FDA registry: 510(k), De Novo, PMA, GUDID). Default: both.

manufacturer.description: Only devices of manufacturers whose name contains these words, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "Medtronic"

device_class.description: Only devices of this risk class, as stored: EU MDR/MDD Class I, IIa, IIb, III; US FDA Class I, II, III; EU IVDR Class A to D; AIMDD (EU active implantables); the IVDD groups; N or U (FDA not classified / unclassified); Unclassified. Default: all.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: find_device_by_identifier
tools.description: Look up devices by one exact regulatory identifier: FDA 510(k), PMA or De Novo number, UDI-DI (GS1 or HIBCC) or EU Basic UDI-DI. Returns exact_matches (the identifier is the device's primary reference or UDI-DI) and related devices that carry it in another field (a Basic UDI-DI or a submission number often covers several models). Use when the question contains an identifier such as K110287 or a GTIN. Do not use for names or free text (use search_devices) or when the slug is already known (use get_device). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

identifier.description: One regulatory identifier, 4 to 60 characters: a 510(k) number (e.g. K110287), PMA number (P123456), De Novo number (DEN250023), UDI-DI (GS1 GTIN such as 00884838023703, or HIBCC) or EU Basic UDI-DI. Spaces and letter case are ignored.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get the DevicErts record of one device by slug. summary (default): names, manufacturer, status, risk class with its legal system, and every authorization or listing with number, dates and status. detail=full adds identifiers (UDI-DI, Basic UDI-DI, catalogue numbers), FDA product codes, EMDN/GMDN codes, EU certificates, FDA recalls, EU market availability and registry properties. Old slugs resolve to the current one. Use when the slug is known and the device's facts are needed. Prefer this over `fetch`. Do not use to find a device (use search_devices or find_device_by_identifier) or when only recalls or only certificates are needed (use get_device_recalls or get_device_certificates, smaller answers). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

detail.description: summary (default): names, manufacturer, status, class, authorizations. full: adds identifiers, nomenclature codes, EU certificates, FDA recalls, EU market availability and registry properties.

tools.name: get_device_recalls
tools.description: List the U.S. FDA recalls linked to one device by slug: recall number, FDA recall class (I, II or III), status (ongoing, completed or terminated), start date, reason, and whether the recall names this device or only its shared 510(k) or PMA submission. Optional status filter; newest first, at most 100. Use when the question is about recalls or field safety actions of a known device. Do not use for recalls across devices, by product, firm or date (use search_recalls), for the whole record (use get_device with detail=full) or to find the device (use search_devices). EU devices without an FDA record have no recall data. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

status.description: Only recalls with this FDA status: ongoing, completed or terminated. Default: all.

tools.name: get_device_certificates
tools.description: List the EU notified-body certificates (from EUDAMED) of one device by slug: certificate number, type, legislation (MDR, IVDR, MDD, IVDD, AIMDD), notified body, issue and expiry dates, status (such as issued, supplemented, suspended, withdrawn) and whether EUDAMED still lists it. Use when the question is about CE certificates, notified bodies or certificate expiry of a known device. Do not use for FDA clearances or approvals (they are authorizations in get_device), for certificates by number, notified body or manufacturer (use search_certificates) or to find the device (use search_devices). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search U.S. FDA medical device recalls across all devices by words (product description, recall reason, recalling firm or recall number), product code, firm, submission number or pathway, start-date range, recall class and status, with offset paging. Returns up to 20 recalls per page, newest first: recall number, class, status, start date, reason, product code, firm, submissions and the name-matched DevicErts manufacturer page, plus total and next_offset. Use when the question covers recalls in general or all recalls of a company, e.g. ongoing Class I recalls of a product code. Do not use for the recalls of one known device (use get_device_recalls) or for EU data (recalls are FDA only). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Words in the product description, recall reason, recalling firm or recall number, 2 to 200 characters. e.g. "infusion pump", "battery", "Z-0079-2022". Default: none.

product_code.description: Only recalls of this three-letter FDA product code. e.g. DXN, FRN. Default: all.

firm.description: Only recalls whose recalling firm name contains these words, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "Medtronic". Default: all.

submission_number.description: Only recalls naming this FDA submission: a 510(k), PMA, De Novo or HDE number. e.g. K132592, P180028. Default: all.

pathway.description: Only recalls naming a submission of this FDA premarket pathway: 510k, pma or denovo. Default: all.

date_from.description: Only recalls started on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. e.g. 2024-01-01. Default: no lower bound.

date_to.description: Only recalls started on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. e.g. 2024-12-31. Default: no upper bound.

recall_class.description: Only recalls of this FDA recall class: Class I (most serious), Class II or Class III. About a third of recalls have no class yet and never match. Default: all.

status.description: Only recalls with this FDA status: ongoing (open), completed or terminated. Default: all.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: search_certificates
tools.description: Search EU notified-body certificates (EUDAMED) by certificate number, notified body number or name, holder name or SRN, legislation (MDR, IVDR), status and validity date, with offset paging. Returns up to 20 certificates per page: number, type, legislation, status, issue and expiry dates, notified body and holder with their DevicErts pages, plus total and next_offset. Use when a certificate number is known, or the question is which certificates a notified body issued or a manufacturer holds. Do not use for the certificates of one known device (use get_device_certificates) or for FDA clearances (use find_device_by_identifier). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

number.description: Certificate number or its beginning, 2 to 60 characters; spaces are ignored. e.g. "2243595CE01", "EPT 0477". Default: none.

notified_body.description: Notified body: its four-digit number (e.g. 0344) or words of its name (e.g. "TÜV SÜD"). Default: all.

manufacturer.description: Certificate holder: words of its name (e.g. "Medtronic") or its EUDAMED SRN (e.g. IE-MF-000011725). Default: all.

legislation.description: Only certificates under this EU regulation: MDR (medical devices) or IVDR (in vitro diagnostics). Default: both.

status.description: Only certificates with this current EUDAMED status: issued, supplemented, amended, reissued, reinstated, restricted, suspended, cancelled or withdrawn. Default: all.

valid_on.description: Only certificates whose validity period (start to expiry) covers this date, YYYY-MM-DD. e.g. 2026-11-16. This checks dates only: a withdrawn or suspended certificate can match, so combine it with status. Default: any date.

include_removed.description: true: also certificates EUDAMED no longer lists. Default false.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: search_manufacturers
tools.description: Search medical device manufacturers by company name, optionally in one country, with offset paging. Returns up to 20 companies per page with slug, page URL and country, the total and next_offset. Use when a company is named or looked for. Do not use to find devices (use search_devices, which also filters by manufacturer name). Pass a slug to get_manufacturer for the company record. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Words of the company name, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "philips", "B. Braun"

country.description: Only manufacturers registered with this country in a registry (EUDAMED or FDA address): a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. e.g. DE, US, NL. Default: all countries.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: get_manufacturer
tools.description: Get the DevicErts record of one manufacturer by slug: name and registered names, country with its basis, registry identifiers (EUDAMED SRN, FDA FEI, DUNS), device counts per registry and risk class, up to 10 of its devices, its EU certificates and up to 10 recent FDA recalls matched to it. Use when the manufacturer slug is known (from search_manufacturers or get_device) and the company profile is needed. Do not use to find a company by name (use search_manufacturers), to list all its devices (use search_devices with the manufacturer filter), or for all its recalls or certificates (use search_recalls with firm, search_certificates with manufacturer). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Manufacturer slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/manufacturers/<slug> URL, as returned by search_manufacturers or get_device. A full page URL is accepted. e.g. philips-medical-systems-nederland-b-v

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Describe the registries DevicErts compiles (EUDAMED, FDA GUDID, 510(k), De Novo, PMA, recalls, establishment registrations): region, record count, last sync date, sync cadence and reuse terms of each, plus the catalogue totals. Takes no arguments. Use when the question is how current or complete the data are, or under which terms they may be reused. Do not use for facts about a device or a company (use search_devices or search_manufacturers). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

tools.name: search_gudid_listings
tools.description: List FDA GUDID listings, one row per listing with its primary UDI-DI, brand or device name, version or model, labeler, risk class and commercial status; records without a primary DI are left out. A query that is a GTIN or HIBCC code is matched to the primary DI first (exact_match true). Optional labeler filter, offset paging, up to 20 rows per page. Use when the question is about GUDID listings or a UDI-DI in the U.S. market, e.g. all listings of a brand. Do not use for a full device record (use get_device), a 510(k), PMA or De Novo number or EU identifiers (use find_device_by_identifier), or devices across all registries (use search_devices). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 200 characters: a UDI-DI (GS1 GTIN or HIBCC), a brand or trade name, a version or model, or the labeler (company) name. e.g. "00884838023703", "HeartStart", "Medtronic"

company.description: Only listings of labelers whose name contains these words, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "Philips". Default: all.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: get_recall
tools.description: Get one U.S. FDA device recall by its recall number: status (ongoing, completed or terminated), FDA recall class, start date, reason, product description, product code, recalling firm, the 510(k), PMA or De Novo numbers it names and the name-matched DevicErts manufacturer page. Use when a recall number is known, such as Z-0079-2022. Do not use to find recalls by product, firm, class or date (use search_recalls) or for the recalls of one device (use get_device_recalls). EU field safety notices (FSCA) are not in the catalogue. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

recall_number.description: The FDA recall number, 3 to 40 characters; letter case and spaces are ignored. e.g. Z-0079-2022, Z-1234-2020

tools.name: search_establishments
tools.description: Search registered establishments: EU economic operators and authorities in EUDAMED (manufacturers, authorised representatives, importers, notified bodies, competent authorities, sponsors) by name, SRN or NB number with role and country filters and offset paging, or one FDA establishment registration by FEI number (a single hit, no paging). Returns up to 20 hits per page (registry, identifier and its type, name, role, country, status, page URL) and next_offset. Use when the question is about a registration identifier (SRN or FEI) or an operator role such as authorised representative. Do not use to find a company profile by name (use search_manufacturers) or its devices (use search_devices). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Establishment name (2 to 100 characters), an EUDAMED SRN (e.g. DE-MF-000012345, FR-CA-008) or an FDA establishment FEI number (5 to 10 digits, e.g. 3002808313). An SRN or a name searches EUDAMED; digits look up the FDA registration.

registry.description: eudamed: EU economic operators and authorities with an SRN, searched by name or SRN. fda: one FDA establishment registration, looked up by FEI number (no name search, one hit, offset must be 0). Default: fda for an all-digit query, otherwise eudamed.

actor_type.description: Only EUDAMED operators of this role: Manufacturer, Authorised Representative, Importer, Notified Body, Competent Authority or Sponsor. Ignored for registry fda. Default: all roles.

country.description: Only EUDAMED operators registered in this country: a two- or three-letter country code. e.g. DE, NL, FR. Ignored for registry fda. Default: all.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search devices in the standard search/fetch connector format: up to 10 results as id, title and url; each id goes to fetch. Use when the client works only with the standard search and fetch pair (ChatGPT connectors and deep research). Do not use when search_devices is available: it adds filters, paging and structured fields. For identifiers use find_device_by_identifier. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 200 characters: device name, type, model or manufacturer. e.g. "insulin pump"

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one record in the standard search/fetch connector format: the device or manufacturer behind a search id (device:<slug> or manufacturer:<slug>) as Markdown text, with its url and metadata (retrieval date, reuse terms). Use when the client works only with the standard search and fetch pair (ChatGPT connectors and deep research). Do not use when get_device or get_manufacturer is available: they return structured fields and a detail level. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

id.description: A result id from search: device:<slug> or manufacturer:<slug>. A device or manufacturer page URL is accepted too. e.g. device:heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028
